$comment: Shipwright upgrades (PRD section 7): installed for good, one of each per ship. Each is a set of stat modifiers: speed adds speed points; upwindDeg lets her sail that many degrees closer to the wind; the *Mult fields multiply crew berths, hull, gun range (round and grape) and reload time. sizes: the settlement sizes whose shipwright sells it. price is what it costs for the 'priceFor' class (the brig, the starting ship); other classes pay by the work, 'per' gun (powder, bronze cannon), hull point (scantlings, copper, a suit of sails) or berth (hammocks) against the brig's, rounded to 10 gold, so a sloop's bronze cannon cost a fraction of a ship of the line's. Era availability waits for eras.

upgrades.name: Cotton sails
upgrades.effect: Sails 8 degrees closer to the wind
